title: HN never sleeps
author: agam
hypothesis: Software engineers are night owls: the quiet hours (00-05 UTC) are about as busy as the peak hours (13-18 UTC).
expect: If true, average hourly items at 00-05 UTC should be within 10% of 13-18 UTC (ratio between 0.9 and 1.1).
caveats: HN is global. 00-05 UTC is daytime in Asia and evening in the Americas, so this tests the crowd, not one person.
